name: What is the R-value, and why is it important for wall insulation?

mainEntity.name: What is the R-value, and why is it important for wall insulation?

acceptedAnswer.text: R-value is a measure of thermal resistance, indicating an insulation material's ability to resist heat flow. A higher R-value means greater insulating power. For wall insulation, a higher R-value helps keep your home warmer in winter and cooler in summer, leading to better energy efficiency. The recommended R-value for walls can vary by climate zone and local building codes. Our team can help determine the appropriate R-value for your home in areas like Irvine to ensure optimal performance and compliance.
